title: Tax Saving (ELSS)
shortText: Equity Linked Savings Schemes with a 3-year lock-in and Section 80C benefit (old regime).
whatItIs: ELSS funds are equity mutual funds with a statutory lock-in of three years. Investments of up to Rs 1.5 lakh a year qualify for deduction under Section 80C if you file under the old tax regime. Because they invest in equities, their value can rise or fall with the market.
whoItSuits: Taxpayers who file under the old tax regime, have not exhausted their Section 80C limit and are comfortable with equity risk and a three-year lock-in.
howItWorks: Check how much of your Section 80C limit is still available
Invest through a monthly SIP or a lump sum before the financial year ends
Download the investment statement for tax proof from your dashboard
Each instalment is locked in for three years from its own date

faqs.question: Can I claim ELSS under the new tax regime?
faqs.answer: No. The Section 80C deduction is available only under the old tax regime.

faqs.question: When can I redeem ELSS units?
faqs.answer: Each purchase can be redeemed three years after its own allotment date.
